novelty_flags.label: Flagship literature map and related_work
novelty_flags.one_line: Add LeeWason2020, the direct two-stage NCC platform comparator: it analyzes all versus concurrent controls under linear and step trends and finds stage adjustment equivalent to concurrent-only analysis, so it is a closer omitted precursor than several currently listed general references.

soundness_flags.label: prop:three-block-kill-test at gamma=0
soundness_flags.one_line: The claimed value L^(3)_{0.1,0}/M=0.7 fails the gamma=0 reduction: fixing all three control outcomes to 0 leaves three indistinguishable treatment values on the Z21=z0 branch; 0.9 unconditional coverage forces at least 0.8 coverage of each there, whose two extreme points require conditional expected length at least 1.6M and hence unconditional worst-case length at least 0.8M.
